textbook_summary: Ventricular rhythm usually 60-100 bpm, between escape rhythm and paroxysmal tachycardia.
Similar atrial and ventricular rates may cause interference dissociation, capture or fusion.

authored_choices.source: Authored broad ventricular electrode QRS and secondary T contour with independent normal P

invariants: Named independent grid rejects changed timings or ordinary/escape pattern substitution
Electrical and mechanical ventricular events share750ms cycle, atrial events800ms
P drifts relative to QRS; no fixed measurable PR
Shared monitorII and twelve-lead projection preserve limb identities and checkpoint phases
12-lead demo rejects undefined combinations atomically and fences prior timer
limitations: Established fixed rhythm only; no automaticity, AV competition, gradual onset/termination, capture or fusion
No anatomical focus localization or AIVR pump calibration
Physiology demo integration is NEXT, not yet implemented
Other accelerated atrial/junctional rhythms and complete TdP remain open
